verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Baseten's product that users can delegate tasks to. What it does document is external: an MCP server and skill so your own coding agent can manage the workspace, and Baseten Switch, which routes Claude Code or Codex CLI requests to Model APIs. These are adjacent integrations for external agents, not an in-product assistant. An in-product assistant is a plausible feature for a platform like this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.
